request_preview: I need three kettles but your price is above what I budgeted. What is the best you can actually do?

json.message: I can offer the three kettles at ₹14,168 total (just over 5.3% off list), which is our best possible rate for this quantity today. If that works for your budget, we can get these processed and shipped right away.
json.rationale: Proposing the maximum allowable discount of 5.36% to fit the buyer's remaining cap while securing the 3-unit sale.
